messages.author: c99b1276ac2c11bd
messages.subject: choiceRT_ddm Error
parts:
Hi,

Thanks for this great package!

I'm trying to model choice RT with DDM, and I keep getting this error:

Error in RTu[i, 1:Nu[i]] <- tmp$RT[tmp$choice == 2] : 
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

The model ran fine with the example data included in the package.

I noticed that only when I equated the number of trials per subject in the data - the model was running (though it didn't get past the "Building a model" announcement).

I'm attaching some sample data (5 subjects). I guess it could be something specific to my data, but hopefully it will be solvable. 

Thanks again,
Maayan

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: choiceRT_ddm Error
parts:
Hi Maayan,

Thanks for your inquiry. I found that there is a minor issue in our code - the choiceRT_* codes work fine when subject IDs sorted in the data file... In your data file, subject IDs are 1, 2, 3, 5, and 4. When I sorted the data (see the attached file), choiceRT_ddm and choiceRT_lba models run without a problem. 

How many subjects and trials/subject do you have? I believe choiceRT_* models should run fine. If you are a Mac/Linux user, I recommend you install hBayesDM through GitHub (https://rpubs.com/CCSL/hBayesDM). Let me know if I can help further. I could catch a bug in the code thanks to your question and I appreciate it!

Best,
Young
